name: Moe Moe Daisensou☆Gendaibaan
original_name: 萌え萌え大戦争☆げんだいばーん
source:
This is an all-ages game with the heroines based off military aircraft and vehicles, and they are known as ‘maidens of steel’. There are three scenarios available: Europe during World War II, the Far East during the Cold War and the Vietnam War, and finally the Middle East during the Iran-Iraq War. The game is broken up into 3 parts: adventure (ADV), simulation (SLG) and communication (COM). The battle system has 3d sprites wandering about the map destroying stuff, although the mechanics are similar to the previous games in the Moe Moe series.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/april-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是一款全年龄游戏，女主角们以军用飞机和车辆为原型，被称为“钢铁少女”。游戏提供三条剧情路线：第二次世界大战时期的欧洲；冷战和越南战争时期的远东；以及两伊战争时期的中东。游戏分为冒险（ADV）、模拟（SLG）和交流（COM）三个部分。战斗中，3D角色会在地图上移动并摧毁目标，系统机制则与《萌萌大战争》系列前作相似。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/04/01/april-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
